# cluster UI changes
Date: 2026-10-23 | Duration: 18.239999771118164m

## Summary
The discussion covered experiment setup, results presentation, health checks, and controls. Checkbox supports progressive disclosure, while cluster experiments disable post-stratification and activation metrics; identifier copies must remain uniform. Results should show adjacent identifiers, allow a subunit-child relationship, clearly call out region-level analysis, and place user IDs after region IDs. Health checks default to user-ID traffic, omit user-level SRM dimensions, and include cluster mapping and assignment checks. Both checks feed status. Opt-out becomes disabled after an experiment starts, while imported experiments remain toggleable. A health-check redesign is planned eventually. Sources: Experiment Setup, Results Display, Health Checks, and Decisions And Next Steps sections.

## Keywords
Cluster experiments, subunit identifiers, post-stratification, SRM checks, health checks, metric granularity

## Action Items
**Michael Samper**
Standardize identifier labels (05:50)
